reason: The proposed action violates the policy constraint for modifying pending orders. The policy states: 'For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.' The agent is attempting to remove items entirely by providing an empty new_item_ids array, which does not satisfy the requirement that each modified item map to 'an available new item.' The policy only permits: (1) modifying items to different variants of the same product, (2) cancelling the entire order, or (3) modifying address/payment. Partial item removal is not supported by the modify_pending_order_items tool or policy.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
Generally, you can only take action on pending or delivered orders.
Exchange or modify order tools can only be called once per order.
